BiblicalUsage: The name is Riblah, a place in Syria. You find the name in 2 Kings 23:33, "…bands at Riblah in the land of Hamath…", and again in Jeremiah 39:5 and Numbers 34:11.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Riblah counts, because the God of the Bible works in places you can find. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
